elements_selected.content: Add ChainLink struct and chain fields to PageContext in src/web/context.rs per CON-015-002. ChainLink has title and slug fields. PageContext gets five new fields: prev_page, next_page, chain_position, chain_length, chain_head_slug. Update build_page_context to call extract_chain_target for prev and next, resolve targets via page_slug_map, and build ChainLink values. Set chain_position and chain_length to None initially -- next task adds walking. REQ-015-007, CON-015-002.
